Name: Simple HD Portraits
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✨ Simple HD Portraits ✨[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#67E8F9]Familiar faces, smoothly illustrated in HD.[/color][/size][/center]

[center]HD portraits inspired by Stardew Valley’s original character designs, expressions and outfits. Covers all 48 original portrait subjects, with close bust framing and built-in HD rendering.[/center]

[center]Previously named Simple Faithful+ Portraits. The mod keeps its existing internal identity and settings.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]✨ New in 1.16 — Eye & portrait-edge cleanup[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Refines seven Leah eye interiors across her standard, winter and beach outfits, smoothing iris contours and softening the exaggerated upward beach gaze. Removes stray crop fragments and faint edge lines from 44 expressions across 13 characters. Existing face designs, expressions, brows, lids, hair, outfits and portrait positioning are retained.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]🖼️ Features[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• 48 original portrait subjects, including the answering-machine prop.
• 101 original outfit variants and 667 occupied expression slots.
• Smooth 256 × 256 artwork per HD expression, with native-size fallback sheets.
• Standard outfits plus matching original winter outfits where available.
• Supported special outfits, including beachwear, work clothing and disguises.
• Built-in HD rendering and portrait preloading.
• Individual character switches for mixing portrait sets.
• Optional Generic Mod Config Menu controls.
• Settings available in all 12 built-in game languages.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]❄️ Outfits & expressions[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Spring, summer and fall use the standard artwork. Winter uses the character’s original winter outfit when one exists, otherwise the standard outfit remains. This collection does not add a different wardrobe for every season.[/center]

[center]Seasonal portraits are enabled by default. Turn them off to keep the loaded original outfit variant. Supported special outfits have their own replacement setting.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]📦 Requirements[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Stardew Valley 1.6 on desktop.
SMAPI 4.2.0 or newer.
Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings.
Content Patcher, Portraiture and HD Portraits are not required.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]🔧 Installation & updates[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download and extract Simple HD Portraits.
3. Place the included SimpleFaithfulPortraits folder inside your Mods folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/center]

[center]When updating, close the game and replace the previous copy of this portrait mod. Keep your config.json to preserve settings, and avoid leaving a second copy under an older folder name.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]⚙️ Settings & compatibility[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Enable or disable the mod, seasonal switching, supported special outfits and individual characters. Without Generic Mod Config Menu, edit the config.json created after the first launch.[/center]

[center]Includes built-in rendering for the vanilla dialogue and shop portrait windows, Simple UI Themes and Simple UI Themes 2, and integration with Simple Animated Portraits.[/center]

[center]If another portrait mod replaces the same character, disable that character here to use the other set. Expansion NPCs and unsupported custom portrait layouts retain their loaded artwork. The optional matching sprite companion remains a separate download with its own artwork.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]💬 Feedback[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]For an expression, outfit or framing issue, please include the character’s name, outfit, season, screenshot and SMAPI log.[/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FDE68A]💜 Credits[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Stardew Valley and original character designs: ConcernedApe.
Mod development and portrait preparation: xSyy.
Portrait artwork uses AI-assisted generation and editing.[/center]
